description:
You are a systems administrator at a university facilities management department. An IT security audit requires you to document the technical specifications of the Emoncms energy monitoring installation.

Navigate to the Emoncms Admin panel (accessible via the top navigation menu under Setup > Admin, or directly at http://localhost/admin/view) and review the system information displayed there.

Create a report file at `/home/ga/system_audit_report.txt` containing the following fields, each on its own line in 'key: value' format:

- emoncms_version: The Emoncms version shown on the admin page
- mysql_version: The MySQL/MariaDB server version
- php_version: The PHP version
- redis_status: Whether Redis is connected (e.g. 'Connected' or 'Not Connected')
- server_os: The server operating system string
- feed_count: The total number of feeds in the system
- input_count: The total number of inputs in the system
- mqtt_status: The MQTT server connection status

Copy the values accurately from what is displayed on the admin page. You may use any method to create the file (text editor, terminal command, etc.).

Example format:
emoncms_version: 11.4.11
mysql_version: 5.7.44
php_version: 8.0.30
redis_status: Connected
server_os: Debian GNU/Linux 11
feed_count: 8
input_count: 6
mqtt_status: Not Connected
